subject: Compressed roadmap walkthrough — aligning exec window & handoff
body:
From: Ben Torres <ben.torres@clearline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Evans <kate.evans@clearline.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compressed QBR/roadmap walkthrough — need a shorter window

Soojin,

Appreciate the heads-up about the renewal QBR. Our execs have a hard 30-minute window next Thursday (7/26) and they want a tight roadmap walkthrough + top 3 asks prioritized. Can you and product present a 25–30 minute version that focuses on:
- What landed since last QBR
- Roadmap highlights that affect our ops in the next 90 days
- Clear action items and owners

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Thu 7/26 10:00–10:30
- Thu 7/26 16:00–16:30

If neither works we can do Fri 7/27 09:00–09:30. Also we need someone on the call who can speak to Dedicated capacity pricing implications.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Torres
Dir., Platform Engineering
Clearline Logistics

---

On Thu, 19 Jul 2028 at 10:03 AM -0700 Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Torres <ben.torres@clearline.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Kate Evans <kate.evans@clearline.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compressed QBR/roadmap walkthrough — need a shorter window

Ben — thanks for the clarity. We can definitely do a condensed 30-min format. Proposed plan:
- 3 min: quick context + renewal status
- 8 min: what shipped (impact highlights)
- 12 min: roadmap snapshots (focus on 3 items that touch Clearline)
- 5 min: immediate asks & owners + next steps

Rishi (cc'd) will cover Dedicated capacity pricing tradeoffs; Grace will run the roadmap slides and keep time. I'm attaching a trimmed agenda (QBR-agenda-v2.pdf) and an updated invite stub.

Suggested slot: Thu 7/26 16:00–16:30 PDT (gives us time to prep). If you prefer morning, we can do 10:00–10:30. I'll drop a calendar poll link below so your team can confirm the best exec-friendly slot.

Calendar poll: https://cal.poll/clearline-qbr-availability
Drive notes: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2BqQ_clearline-roadmap-notes
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/CL-4892

Would you like us to include a one-pager on Dedicated pricing scenarios (T-shirt sizing) in the invite? That could help the execs decide quickly.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sr. AM, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR-agenda-v2.pdf (2 pages)
Attachment: clearline-updated-invite.ics

> On Thu, 19 Jul 2028 at 09:12 AM -0700 Ben Torres <ben.torres@clearline.com> wrote:
> Soojin,
> 
> Appreciate the heads-up about the renewal QBR...

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@clearline.com>, Kate Evans <kate.evans@clearline.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compressed QBR/roadmap walkthrough — need a shorter window

Agree with the format. I'll prepare a 2-slide pricing summary:
- Slide 1: Dedicated capacity tiers + expected throughput and latency gains
- Slide 2: Quick cost delta and recommended fallback for short-term burst (hosted fallback)

If execs want numbers, I can call out egress, instance sizing, and likely monthly commit ranges. If you want a hard ask, we should include an approval checkbox for a 3-month pilot commit so they can greenlight on the call.

Rishi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@clearline.com>, Kate Evans <kate.evans@clearline.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compressed QBR/roadmap walkthrough — need a shorter window

I'll tighten the slides to 4 visuals total and call out the three Clearline-impact features with one sentence each. Also will add a visible 'decision requested' footer so execs know the exact ask at minute 25.

I can host the shared deck during the call and do a 60-second demo of the Dedicated UI if you want, but that demo would be ~2 minutes and we'd need to shave elsewhere.

Grace
Product Lead, Inference UX — Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Torres <ben.torres@clearline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Evans <kate.evans@clearline.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compressed QBR/roadmap walkthrough — need a shorter window

16:00 slot works for our execs. Please keep it tight — they will not tolerate runover. If you include the 3-month pilot ask, we need a one-slide ask and an OK/no-OK quick poll in the calendar invite.

Thanks — see you Thursday.
Ben

---

From: Kate Evans <kate.evans@clearline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@clearline.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compressed QBR/roadmap walkthrough — need a shorter window

Added the 16:00–16:30 invite to everyone's calendar and accepted. Please attach the one-pager on Dedicated pricing to the invite so the execs have it in advance.

Kate
VP, Product Ops
Clearline Logistics

---

Notes/next steps (internal):
- Soojin: finalize attendee list and update invite with one-slide ask + polling option (due 7/22 EOD)
- Rishi: prepare 2-slide pricing and pilot ask (due 7/24)
- Grace: trim deck to 4 visuals and prep 60s demo (dry run 7/25)
- Attach QBR-agenda-v2.pdf and clearline-updated-invite.ics to final invite
